signup.tutorIntentHelp: You'll be able to verify your identity later to unlock the family plan as a Tutor.
signup.universalNote: Everyone starts with a free universal account, no documents needed to sign up.
signup.confirmBody: We sent a confirmation link to {{email}}. Open it to activate your account.
signup.birthDateHint: We check it and do not keep it. An account here is for adults.
signup.ageBlockedTitle: An adult has to create this one
signup.ageBlockedBody: You can keep learning right now without an account, and nothing is lost. When a parent or guardian is with you, they can create your account from their own and you will keep everything you have done.

verify.title: Become a Tutor
verify.subtitle: Verify your identity to manage your family
verify.privacyNote: Your ID photo is checked in memory and immediately discarded, it is never saved, stored, or shared. Only the details you type below are kept once verification succeeds.
verify.birthDateHint: Format: yyyy-mm-dd, exactly as it appears on your ID
verify.photoHelp: A sharp, well-lit photo of the front of a valid ID. JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 8 MB.
verify.successBody: Your identity was verified. You can now set up your family, add kids, and assign tasks with rewards.
verify.retryHint: Try a sharper, well-lit photo, or a different valid ID. Your photo was not kept.

checks.documentReadable: The photo is too blurry or dark to read
checks.nameMatch: The name doesn't match the document
checks.birthDateMatch: The date of birth doesn't match the document
checks.notExpired: The document seems to be expired

verify.alreadyBody: This account has already been verified. Family management lives in your dashboard.
verify.introBody: Three things happen, in this order. It takes about a minute.
verify.step1: You tell us your name and date of birth, exactly as they appear on your ID.
verify.step2: You photograph the document. We read it, compare the two, and answer.
verify.step3: The photo is never stored. Not by us, not anywhere. Only the four checks and what you typed are kept.
verify.failHelpBody: A blurry photo, a glare on the plastic or a cropped edge is usually the reason. If it keeps failing, write to us and a person will look at it.
